record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764>, A Psalm<WH04210> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> I waited<WH06960><WTH8765> patiently<WH06960><WTH8763> for the LORD<WH03068>; and he inclined<WH05186><WTH8799> unto me, and heard<WH08085><WTH8799> my cry<WH07775>. <RF>I waited...: Heb. In waiting I waited<Rf>

He brought me up<WH05927><WTH8686> also out of an horrible<WH07588> pit<WH0953>, out of the miry<WH03121> clay<WH02916>, and set<WH06965><WTH8686> my feet<WH07272> upon a rock<WH05553>, <FI>and<Fi> established<WH03559><WTH8790> my goings<WH0838>. <RF>an...: Heb. a pit of noise<Rf>

And he hath put<WH05414><WTH8799> a new<WH02319> song<WH07892> in my mouth<WH06310>, <FI>even<Fi> praise<WH08416> unto our God<WH0430>: many<WH07227> shall see<WH07200><WTH8799> <FI>it<Fi> , and fear<WH03372><WTH8799>, and shall trust<WH0982><WTH8799> in the LORD<WH03068>.

Blessed<WH0835> <FI>is<Fi> that man<WH01397> that maketh<WH07760><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> his trust<WH04009>, and respecteth<WH06437><WTH8804> not the proud<WH07295>, nor such as turn aside<WH07750><WTH8802> to lies<WH03577>.

Many<WH07227>, O LORD<WH03068> my God<WH0430>, <FI>are<Fi> thy wonderful<WH06381><WTH8737> works <FI>which<Fi> thou hast done<WH06213><WTH8804>, and thy thoughts<WH04284> <FI>which are<Fi> to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order<WH06186><WTH8800> unto thee: <FI>if<Fi> I would declare<WH05046><WTH8686> and speak<WH01696><WTH8762> <FI>of them<Fi> , they are more<WH06105><WTH8804> than can be numbered<WH05608><WTH8763>. <RF>they cannot...: or, none can order them unto thee<Rf><CM>

Sacrifice<WH02077> and offering<WH04503> thou didst not desire<WH02654><WTH8804>; mine ears<WH0241> hast thou opened<WH03738><WTH8804>: burnt offering<WH05930> and sin offering<WH02401> hast thou not required<WH07592><WTH8804>. <RF>opened: Heb. digged<Rf>
Then said<WH0559><WTH8804> I, Lo, I come<WH0935><WTH8804>: in the volume<WH04039> of the book<WH05612> <FI>it is<Fi> written<WH03789><WTH8803> of me,

I delight<WH02654><WTH8804> to do<WH06213><WTH8800> thy will<WH07522>, O my God<WH0430>: yea, thy law<WH08451> <FI>is<Fi> within<WH08432> my heart<WH04578>. <RF>within...: Heb. in the midst of my bowels<Rf>

I have preached<WH01319><WTH8765> righteousness<WH06664> in the great<WH07227> congregation<WH06951>: lo, I have not refrained<WH03607><WTH8799> my lips<WH08193>, O LORD<WH03068>, thou knowest<WH03045><WTH8804>.

I have not hid<WH03680><WTH8765> thy righteousness<WH06666> within<WH08432> my heart<WH03820>; I have declared<WH0559><WTH8804> thy faithfulness<WH0530> and thy salvation<WH08668>: I have not concealed<WH03582><WTH8765> thy lovingkindness<WH02617> and thy truth<WH0571> from the great<WH07227> congregation<WH06951>.<CM>
Withhold<WH03607><WTH8799> not thou thy tender mercies<WH07356> from me, O LORD<WH03068>: let thy lovingkindness<WH02617> and thy truth<WH0571> continually<WH08548> preserve<WH05341><WTH8799> me.

For innumerable<WH04557> evils<WH07451> have compassed<WH0661><WTH8804> me about: mine iniquities<WH05771> have taken hold<WH05381><WTH8689> upon me, so that I am not able<WH03201><WTH8804> to look up<WH07200><WTH8800>; they are more<WH06105><WTH8804> than the hairs<WH08185> of mine head<WH07218>: therefore my heart<WH03820> faileth<WH05800><WTH8804> me. <RF>falleth: Heb. forsaketh<Rf>
Be pleased<WH07521><WTH8798>, O LORD<WH03068>, to deliver<WH05337><WTH8687> me: O LORD<WH03068>, make haste<WH02363><WTH8798> to help<WH05833> me.

Let them be ashamed<WH0954><WTH8799> and confounded<WH02659><WTH8799> together<WH03162> that seek<WH01245><WTH8764> after my soul<WH05315> to destroy<WH05595><WTH8800> it; let them be driven<WH05472><WTH8735> backward<WH0268> and put to shame<WH03637><WTH8735> that wish<WH02655> me evil<WH07451>.
Let them be desolate<WH08074><WTH8799> for a reward<WH06118> of their shame<WH01322> that say<WH0559><WTH8802> unto me, Aha<WH01889>, aha<WH01889>.

Let all those that seek<WH01245><WTH8764> thee rejoice<WH07797><WTH8799> and be glad<WH08055><WTH8799> in thee: let such as love<WH0157><WTH8802> thy salvation<WH08668> say<WH0559><WTH8799> continually<WH08548>, The LORD<WH03068> be magnified<WH01431><WTH8799>.

But I <FI>am<Fi> poor<WH06041> and needy<WH034>; <FI>yet<Fi> the Lord<WH0136> thinketh<WH02803><WTH8799> upon me: thou <FI>art<Fi> my help<WH05833> and my deliverer<WH06403><WTH8764>; make no tarrying<WH0309><WTH8762>, O my God<WH0430>.<CM>
